name: CC Xtracts Liquid Diamond Disposable | Rainbow Belts
description:
Discover Ritual by Fresh Coast, a premium 2-gram disposable vape crafted with Liquid Diamonds and all-natural terpenes. Built with a state-of-the-art, ceramic, postless design, it ensures pure, satisfying pulls every time.

Key Features:

• Ceramic, Postless Design: No metal or cotton, eliminating metallic or burnt aftertastes. Experience clean, natural flavor from start to finish.

• 2g V-Shaped Tank: This 2g tank is designed to optimize oil efficiency, delivering a rich, consistent experience till the last drop.

• NEVER Converted Oil: Only authentic oil and ethical practices go into each vape, ensuring purity and quality you can trust.

• USB-C Rechargeable: Convenient recharging for extended use, keeping you powered on the go.

Order now to be among the first to experience this Ritual of purity and quality!
